column1: # The script that draws each panel file. The index (INDEX.md) and the manifest take the script of a panel from here, and
# the build names every panel of a figure that has no row. panels: one or more "family/name" under figures/panels/,
# separated by spaces (shell patterns; the first matching row counts), or a path under notebooks/figures/ for a panel
# stored by a notebook. A folder whose panels come from several scripts lists its panels by name, so that a new panel
# has no script until its row is written. command: run from the repository root in the analysis environment
# (chimera_env) with PYTHONPATH set to the repository root; it reads stored runs, caches and result tables only.
